The '''recipe browser''' looks up any item's recipes in [[Matcha Flavoured]]: every way to make it, everything it is used to make, and a crafting tree that follows each ingredient down to raw materials. It covers the pack's recipes and the vanilla recipes it keeps, at the [[Crafting Table]], [[Oven]], [[Mud Kiln]], [[Blast Furnace]], [[Kindling]], [[Smithing Table]] and [[Stonecutter]], and the villagers' [[Trading|trades]]. Recipes are shown on the station screens the articles use; hover over a slot for the item's tooltip.

<div id="mfw-recipes" class="mfw-recipes" data-src="/_static/recipes.json">
The recipe browser runs on the published site and needs JavaScript. Every item's page also lists its recipes and uses.
</div>
